Rayquaza

Dragon Flying

Hoenn · Generation 3 · Legendary Pokémon

Rayquaza is a Dragon/Flying-type Sky High Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 7 m tall and weighs 206.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (150), with a base stat total of 680.
